run_locobot_smoke_test: run the smoke test to fetch RGB and depth images from a LoCoBot robot over Pyro4
create_locobot_mover_proxy: create a LoCoBotMover instance that connects to a remote LoCoBot via Pyro4 at a given IP
get_rgb_depth_images: get RGB and depth image arrays from a remote LoCoBot using the get_rgb_depth method
review_locobot_mover_class: review the LoCoBotMover class and its Pyro4 proxy initialization for remote robot communication
test_locobot_pyro4_connection: test the Pyro4 connection to a LoCoBot by fetching RGB and depth images five times with timing
